design.withholding_unit: network.segments() branches cut into chunks with max_len_px=12

notes: The transfer runner calls shared build_holdout(); HoldoutContext.visible() returns catalogue & ~hidden and does not remove a feature-context collar around withheld pixels.
The shared legacy builder withholds short chunks (maximum 12 px), not whole connected fault segments.
Its 12 px erosion separates scored quadrants from their boundaries; it is not a buffer around withheld fault segments.

The required buffered whole-component API already exists in the shared template as buffered_component_draw(), and other repository runners use it. This archived transfer result was not evaluated with that protocol.
No experiment was rerun and no candidate TIFF was generated during this code review.
